identity.name: Scroll.in
identity.description: An Indian digital news and culture publication known for independent reporting, analysis, long-form journalism and coverage of rights, politics and society.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Founded by Samir Patil and owned by Scroll Media Inc., with funding from Omidyar Network and the Media Development Investment Fund. Editorially independent of government.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Digital-native outlet with philanthropic and reader support, a public editor and a record of critical reporting on Indian authorities.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed centre-left based on its rights, inequality and civil-liberties coverage.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is policy- and society-oriented rather than consistently pro-market.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Indian national lens with strong attention to minorities, rights, culture and inequality.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional reporting with named authors and corrections; no external factual rating parsed in this review.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No MBFC rating identified for Scroll.in.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Independent Indian digital journalism with a rights-and-culture lens. It favours explanatory and long-form treatment over speed.

selectionRationale: Adds independent Indian civil-society and culture coverage that complements legacy newspapers.

feeds.validationNote: 100 items; valid FeedBurner RSS; primary scroll.in/feed was invalid.

research.researchNotes: Official About page returned 404; ownership from Wikipedia and disclosed funding references. FeedBurner endpoint validated after the site feed returned zero entries. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
